title: CorridorWs
description: client: messages the front end sends; server: messages it receives.

AddThreat.description:
The command reports an enemy threat or a zone to avoid; the server gives it an id.

A radar and a zone to avoid take ``radius_m``, an enemy jammer ``eirp_w`` and ``bands``.

radius_m.description: Radar range or radius of the zone to avoid, metres.
radius_m.title: Radius M

AddThreat.title: AddThreat

Antenna.description:
Directional antenna, seen from above: a main beam with a hard edge, sidelobes elsewhere.

The cone is horizontal only: the planner is 2D plus time.

azimuth_deg.description: Axis of the main beam, degrees clockwise from north.
azimuth_deg.title: Azimuth Deg

beamwidth_deg.description: Full width of the main beam.
beamwidth_deg.title: Beamwidth Deg

sidelobe_db.description: Gain outside the main beam, relative to the main beam (e.g. -20).
sidelobe_db.title: Sidelobe Db

Antenna.title: Antenna

AvoidZone.description:
Area the command advises against (reported activity, no located emitter).

Shown with the threats and in each mission's zones, but not forbidden: the planner may cross
it. Making routes avoid it when there is a reasonable alternative is still to do.
AvoidZone.title: AvoidZone

ChooseRoute.description:
The pilot picks one of the route choices of its current plan.

A choice needing cuts asks the command, which answers until a deadline; ``on_timeout``
says what happens if it has not by then.
ChooseRoute.title: ChooseRoute

ConfirmCut.description: Only the command confirms a cut; the jammer operator then carries it out.
ConfirmCut.title: ConfirmCut

Cut.description:
A window during which a friendly jammer is off.

Only a confirmed cut may be used by the planner for the approved route.

requested_for.description: Mission the cut was asked for; None: from the scenario.
requested_for.title: Requested For

Cut.title: Cut

cut.description: The cut as it was before cancellation.

DecideRoute.description: The command accepts or refuses the pending route request of a mission.
DecideRoute.title: DecideRoute

link_min_dbm.title: Link Min Dbm

MissionCreated.description:
A pilot's request became a mission. Clients that see it get a new snapshot right after:
the mission may bring jammers and threats into their view.
MissionCreated.title: MissionCreated

MissionUpdated.description:
A mission on the ground got new points or a new departure; its plan is dropped and a
new one requested. Every client gets a new snapshot right after: the mission may enter or
leave its view.
MissionUpdated.title: MissionUpdated

constraints.description: Grid, zones for this pilot, concerned jammers and threats.

Command the recipient is expected to send back, shown as a button.

At ``at_s`` the command reports an enemy threat or a zone to avoid (as ``threat.add``).
The engine gives it the next free id: R2 after R1, E2 after E1, A1 for the first zone.
